implementation_observed_after_initial_re.interpretation: Source implementation exists, but source presence is not executed packet/cortex evidence and does not satisfy the handoff acceptance booleans by itself.

source_review_product_negative_candidate.observation: The implementation exposes emit_intent(..., tool_ref=...) without an output/tool ownership epoch or cancellation generation check. cancel_for_barge_in changes output playback state but does not invalidate tool/result ownership.
source_review_product_negative_candidate.risk: A late tool completion from an interrupted turn can still be emitted into the active session unless a caller outside this module supplies an unproven fence.

source_review_product_negative_candidate.observation: close_session() creates VoiceOutcome after merely requiring all outputs to be terminal. It does not require a commit_eligible output, bind heard_fraction, or prove that result_ref/result_sha256 refers only to heard committed content.
source_review_product_negative_candidate.risk: A session whose generated output was cancelled/interrupted can still create a terminal VoiceOutcome with a result reference, so unheard/cancelled output noncommit is not causally enforced in this adapter.

source_review_product_negative_candidate.observation: accept_input() stores _input_seen[packet_id] = digest before corrupt/drop/reorder and sequence checks complete.
source_review_product_negative_candidate.risk: A drop/reorder/corrupt injection can consume the packet identity before admission. A corrected retry with the same packet_id but changed fault metadata is then rejected as changed-content replay, while an exact retry is treated as duplicate. Recovery policy is therefore not demonstrated and may be impossible for that identity.

source_review_product_negative_candidate.observation: No snapshot/restart/reconnect restore API or persisted reducer-state contract was observed in voice_packet_cortex.py.
source_review_product_negative_candidate.risk: The owner-authority requirement for restart/recovery without cancelled-output resurrection is not implemented by this module at the reviewed source revision.

source_review_product_negative_candidate.observation: _input_seen, _last_input_sequence, _final_turns, _outputs and _events are retained without an observed compaction/bounding policy.
source_review_product_negative_candidate.risk: Long-conversation packet state grows with session history and does not yet prove the required bounded-state property.

falsifier_invariants.requirement: A repeated packet_id with byte-identical payload must not advance semantic turn/memory/tool/output ownership or VoiceOutcome twice; a repeated packet_id with different payload must fail closed as identity corruption.
Legal ASR partial revisions for one turn must be distinguishable from sequence gaps/reordering and must not cause duplicate semantic commit.
A missing sequence number must never be silently skipped. Buffer, reject or explicit recovery is acceptable only when policy/state transition is deterministic and traceable.
Barge-in/cancel must invalidate active output/tool ownership so late generation/TTS/tool completions from the cancelled epoch cannot leak into the next turn.
Partially heard output may create observational outcome evidence, but unheard tail and fully unheard cancelled output must never become semantic memory/result commit.
heard_fraction stays in [0,1], never decreases, and stale terminal events cannot resurrect interrupted/cancelled output.
Restart/reconnect restores only admitted durable session facts and cannot resurrect cancelled output, stale tool ownership, superseded partials or old endpoint timers.
Tool results bind to originating session/turn/ownership identity and cannot silently mutate successor turns after interruption.
WAIT/backchannel behavior must not close the turn or mint final answer outcome while user input remains open.
Semantic/silence close is deterministic; duplicate close is idempotent and post-close input needs explicit reopen/new-session policy.
Long-session retained transient packet state must be bounded while preserving replay/idempotency guarantees.
Packet adapter must not become competing UnifiedDB, EffectGate/EffectJournal, GWT truth, release, receipt or runtime authority.
Executed packet tests bind explicit zero outbound model/ASR/TTS inference evidence; source review alone is insufficient.
Packet tests can promote only packet/controller scope; acoustic/WER/AEC/physical latency/device/whole-voice/whole-product remain zero.
